recipe-section-1.markdown:
- **600 g** fresh blueberries (rinsed) ([**7:54**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IyBHs4ApmGQ&t=474s))
- **100 g** white sugar ([**2:56**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IyBHs4ApmGQ&t=176s))
- **50 g** brown sugar ([**2:56**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IyBHs4ApmGQ&t=176s))
- **15 g** cornstarch ([**2:14**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IyBHs4ApmGQ&t=134s))
- **4 g** white vinegar ([**2:43**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IyBHs4ApmGQ&t=163s))
- **10–15 mL** ground cinnamon ([**4:50**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IyBHs4ApmGQ&t=290s))

• 600 g fresh blueberries (rinsed) (7:54)
  • 100 g white sugar (2:56)
  • 50 g brown sugar (2:56)
  • 15 g cornstarch (2:14)

  • 10–15 mL ground cinnamon (4:50)
recipe-section-1.title: Blueberry Filling

recipe-section-2.markdown:
- **180 g** all-purpose flour ([**0:46**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IyBHs4ApmGQ&t=46s))
- **14 g** baking soda ([**0:55**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IyBHs4ApmGQ&t=55s))
- **4 g** salt ([**1:32**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IyBHs4ApmGQ&t=92s))
- **2 g** fresh ginger ([**1:23**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IyBHs4ApmGQ&t=83s))
- **2 g** ginger powder ([**1:23**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IyBHs4ApmGQ&t=83s))
- **300 mL** heavy cream (split into 250 mL + 50 mL) ([**5:09**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IyBHs4ApmGQ&t=309s))
- **A small splash** of water (if needed to loosen the batter) ([**6:17**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IyBHs4ApmGQ&t=377s))
- **150 mL** melted butter ([**3:52**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IyBHs4ApmGQ&t=232s)) []

• 180 g all-purpose flour (0:46)
  • 14 g baking soda (0:55)

  • 2 g fresh ginger (1:23)
  • 2 g ginger powder (1:23)
  • 300 mL heavy cream (split into 250 mL + 50 mL) (5:09)

  • 150 mL melted butter (3:52) []
recipe-section-2.title: Batter & Assembly

recipe-section-4.markdown:
- Turn on your kitchen scale and place a large mixing bowl on top ([**0:46**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IyBHs4ApmGQ&t=46s)).
- Weigh out **180 g of all-purpose flour** ([**0:46**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IyBHs4ApmGQ&t=46s)).
- Add **14 g of baking soda**, **2 g of fresh ginger**, **2 g of ginger powder**, and **4 g of salt** ([**0:55**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IyBHs4ApmGQ&t=55s)). *(Note: In the winter, you can also add nutmeg, allspice, or cardamom (*[***1:44***](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IyBHs4ApmGQ&t=104s)*)).*
- Whisk everything together until thoroughly incorporated and set aside ([**1:57**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IyBHs4ApmGQ&t=117s))
recipe-section-4.html:
• Turn on your kitchen scale and place a large mixing bowl on top (0:46).
  • Weigh out 180 g of all-purpose flour (0:46).
  • Add 14 g of baking soda, 2 g of fresh ginger, 2 g of ginger powder, and 4 g of salt (0:55). (Note: In the winter, you can also add nutmeg, allspice, or cardamom (1:44)).
  • Whisk everything together until thoroughly incorporated and set aside (1:57)
recipe-section-4.title: Step 1: Prep the Dry Ingredients

recipe-section-5.markdown:
1. Place your rinsed blueberries into a separate bowl on the scale and zero it out ([**2:05**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IyBHs4ApmGQ&t=125s)).
2. Add **15 g of cornstarch** directly to the berries ([**2:14**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IyBHs4ApmGQ&t=134s)). Unlike the peach cobbler, this requires *no stovetop cooking* because everything will burst and get ooey-gooey in the oven ([**2:25**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IyBHs4ApmGQ&t=145s)).
3. Add **4 g of white vinegar**, **100 g of white sugar**, **50 g of brown sugar**, and **10–15 mL of cinnamon** ([**2:43**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IyBHs4ApmGQ&t=163s)). Mix gently to combine ([**3:52**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IyBHs4ApmGQ&t=232s)).
recipe-section-5.html:
1. Place your rinsed blueberries into a separate bowl on the scale and zero it out (2:05).
  2. Add 15 g of cornstarch directly to the berries (2:14). Unlike the peach cobbler, this requires no stovetop cooking because everything will burst and get ooey-gooey in the oven (2:25).
  3. Add 4 g of white vinegar, 100 g of white sugar, 50 g of brown sugar, and 10–15 mL of cinnamon (2:43). Mix gently to combine (3:52).
recipe-section-5.title: Step 2: Prepare the Blueberry Filling

recipe-section-6.markdown:
1. Melt your butter on the stove ([**0:34**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IyBHs4ApmGQ&t=34s)). Measure out exactly **150 mL of melted butter** and pour it directly into the bottom of a large baking casserole dish ([**3:28**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IyBHs4ApmGQ&t=208s)). *(Tip: Use a large dish to prevent the cobbler from spilling over (*[***7:01***](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IyBHs4ApmGQ&t=421s)*)).*
2. Grab your dry ingredient bowl and pour in **250 mL of heavy cream** ([**5:09**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IyBHs4ApmGQ&t=309s)). Begin mixing ([**5:20**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IyBHs4ApmGQ&t=320s)).
3. If the batter is too thick, pour in an extra **50 mL of heavy cream** and a tiny splash of water ([**6:02**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IyBHs4ApmGQ&t=362s)). Whisk until it reaches a smooth, slightly loose pancake-batter consistency ([**5:27**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IyBHs4ApmGQ&t=327s)).
4. Pour the batter right over the melted butter in the baking dish and spread it out evenly ([**6:49**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IyBHs4ApmGQ&t=409s)). **Do not stir the batter and butter together** ([**7:11**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IyBHs4ApmGQ&t=431s)).
5. Carefully spoon the spiced blueberry mixture evenly across the top of the batter ([**7:11**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IyBHs4ApmGQ&t=431s)).
recipe-section-6.html:
1. Melt your butter on the stove (0:34). Measure out exactly 150 mL of melted butter and pour it directly into the bottom of a large baking casserole dish (3:28). (Tip: Use a large dish to prevent the cobbler from spilling over (7:01)).
  2. Grab your dry ingredient bowl and pour in 250 mL of heavy cream (5:09). Begin mixing (5:20).
  3. If the batter is too thick, pour in an extra 50 mL of heavy cream and a tiny splash of water (6:02). Whisk until it reaches a smooth, slightly loose pancake-batter consistency (5:27).
  4. Pour the batter right over the melted butter in the baking dish and spread it out evenly (6:49). Do not stir the batter and butter together (7:11).
  5. Carefully spoon the spiced blueberry mixture evenly across the top of the batter (7:11).
recipe-section-6.title: Step 3: Mix the Batter & Assemble

recipe-section-7.markdown:
1. Preheat your oven to **190 °C** ([**7:30**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IyBHs4ApmGQ&t=450s)).
2. Bake the cobbler for **50 minutes** ([**8:06**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IyBHs4ApmGQ&t=486s)). As it bakes, the batter will magically float to the top and turn into a big, fluffy biscuit crust ([**7:20**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IyBHs4ApmGQ&t=440s)).
3. Let it cool slightly, then serve! Warm alongside a slice of cheesecake for a deeply indulgent dessert ([**8:13**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IyBHs4ApmGQ&t=493s)).
recipe-section-7.html:
1. Preheat your oven to 190 °C (7:30).
  2. Bake the cobbler for 50 minutes (8:06). As it bakes, the batter will magically float to the top and turn into a big, fluffy biscuit crust (7:20).
  3. Let it cool slightly, then serve! Warm alongside a slice of cheesecake for a deeply indulgent dessert (8:13).
